findings.summary: _STORAGE_FAILURE matches storage phrases case-insensitively against every line of an arm's output, so a genuine test failure whose own message names one is read as the node's disk and its real failure ids are discarded; tests/test_ledger_write_keeps_run_files.py:253 raises OSError(errno.ENOSPC, 'No space left on device'), so such a message is reachable in this repository's own arms. Scope the match to pytest's setup-error and tree-extraction line shapes. Carried from the prior review's finding 1, which the coordinator folded into delivered-work-lands-without-a-coordinator-s71.

The new environmental branch for a guard containing ' arm could not run on ', and the sibling branch at reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:2296 in armed_observations, have no test anywhere under tests/ (grep for 'could not run on' in tests/ hits only the new fixture's comment), so a regression that deleted either would leave the suite green and a storage refusal would be held as a finding about the code instead of retried.

The live-reproduction paragraph says the first two gate submissions are 'kept under the run directory' and quotes their arm-log readings ('no tests ran', 'EXIT=4'; '9 failures and 36 errors'), but no retained file supports either: logs/sbatch-gate2.log holds only tar 'No space left on device' lines, logs/sbatch-gate3.log is 319 bytes of fence and tmpfs lines with no pytest output, and the reviewed run's own manifest calls these 'arms lost to full compute-node /tmp'. Cite the retained receipts only, or say the arm logs were removed on the node.

The artifacts line cites logs/head-newtest.log as '4 passed in 1.73s locally' while that file reads '1 failed in 2.45s' and was written before the fix commit 4d42346e22; the green evidence is ~/.cache/reckon-portfolio/arms/s67-head-newtest.log (4 passed in 2.53s), outside the run directory. Carried from the prior review's finding 0, which the coordinator exempted on that external log; the misquote itself remains in the manifest.

justifications.durability: The retry/naming assertions in tests/test_a_full_disk_is_not_a_test_failure.py:155-207 redden if the storage branch is removed (base arm: 4 failed), yet reckon/crew/queue_landing.py:604 and reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:2296 carry the same judgement with no test at all.
justifications.evidence: The two gate arms at d7f54a14 and 5b013e015a carry identical 11-id failure sets (sorted diff empty), but the done_when's named test is absent from both arm commands (grep count 0 in each log) and logs/head-newtest.log is a pre-fix red run.
justifications.fit: ruff check on the three changed files at head reports 'All checks passed', and the added names (storage_failure, arm_node, exclude_nodes, storage_retry) describe mechanism with no plan, sprint or ticket label.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:1983-1993 names the arm's node and reads no test ids from a storage-failing arm, which is the goal verbatim.
justifications.reuse: No storage classifier exists under reckon/ at head (git grep for 'no space left on device', 'ENOSPC', 'disk quota exceeded' hits only the new pattern), and exclude_nodes extends partition_submission/_partition_runner rather than forking them.
justifications.scope_discipline: git diff --stat d7f54a14..996de76011 lists only the evidence fragment, reckon/crew/landing_measure.py, reckon/crew/queue_landing.py and tests/test_a_full_disk_is_not_a_test_failure.py, every one of them a declared write path.

verdicts.diff: Read commit by commit against d7f54a14: 4d42346e22 adds the storage classifier, Arm.node/storage_failure, Measurement.storage_node/storage_retry, the exclude_nodes plumbing and the environmental branch; 5b013e015a names eighteen distinct files in the fixture; 12936c291a and 996de76011 add the evidence fragment; a6c2988a is a clean merge of main that keeps every added symbol and behaviour.
verdicts.done_when: The done_when names tests/test_a_full_disk_is_not_a_test_failure.py covering three cases; all four of its cases exist and pass at head a6c2988a (re-run here: 4 passed in 1.40s) and fail at base d7f54a14 (4 failed in 0.81s), but the file is in neither gate-arm command and the run's own green log is a stale red, so the pass is recorded outside the run directory.
verdicts.goal: The node's goal is that a full disk on an arm's node is not a test failure; reckon/crew/landing_measure.py:551 classifies the storage line, :1248 suppresses the arm's failing ids, and :1983 breaks the judged-arm loop naming the node, delivering exactly that.
verdicts.manifest: Read; it records base d7f54a14 and head 5b013e015a arms at 11 failed / 597 passed each, names the gate and negative-control logs, and its artifacts line cites logs/head-newtest.log as a green run where logs/head-newtest.log reads '1 failed in 2.45s'.
verdicts.write_paths: The manifest declares five paths; the node's own four commits touch the evidence fragment, reckon/crew/landing_measure.py, reckon/crew/queue_landing.py and the test file, all inside them, and the remaining 108 paths in d7f54a14..a6c2988a come from the merge of main, not from this node.
